definition: Tensor Processing Unit, a custom hardware accelerator designed by Google specifically for accelerating machine learning workloads, particularly tensor operations.
details: TPUs are used extensively for training and serving large-scale models, offering high throughput for the matrix multiplications central to neural network computation.
story: Picture an engineer at a cluttered workbench, turning a clever idea over in their hands until it finally clicks. In plain words: Tensor Processing Unit, a custom hardware accelerator designed by Google specifically for accelerating machine learning workloads, particularly tensor operations. Here is how it actually plays out: TPUs are used extensively for training and serving large-scale models, offering high throughput for the matrix multiplications central to neural network computation. It is one of those ideas that feels obvious only after someone shows it to you. And that idea, made concrete, is TPU.
